messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts detected for /v1/generate (us-east-1). Alert INC-20260315-01. Start: 2026-03-15T09:12:00Z. Paging on-call SREs and scheduler/ingress teams.

sre-oncall: On it. Observing a big spike in 502/504s and long tail latencies. Marking P1. @ingress-eng-maya @scheduler-eng-rajesh please triage.

ingress-eng-maya: Pulling gateway logs now. Quick summary: 502s with "upstream prematurely closed connection", large queue depth at gateway batching layer. Region us-east queue depth ~24k requests. p95 token latency >5s.

ingress-eng-maya: 
```
# curl -s -D- -o /dev/null https://api.redwood.run/v1/generate -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n"
502 2.34
```

scheduler-eng-rajesh: Looking at scheduler traces — batch formation is stalling due to head-of-line blocking. KV cache growth observed + long GC spikes on some nodes. Sample logs: 
```
[09:11:32] batcher: enqueue req id=abcd wait=8000ms; queue_size=24123
[09:11:33] scheduler: alloc failed, timeout=5000ms, err=deadline exceeded
[09:11:34] kvcache: mem=93% growth, evicting oldest keys
```

customer-success-leah: Heads-up: ACME-INC reporting 504s for chat/embedding paths in us-east. They've escalated to SRE support channel.

deploy-bot: Deploy event: scheduler v2.3.4 rolled to us-east-1 @ 2026-03-15T08:59:02Z (canary -> 30% -> 100% in progress at time alert fired).

ingress-eng-maya: Noted correlation: v2.3.4 changed default batch_window_ms from 50 -> 200ms for throughput tuning. That would increase batch sizes and can create HOL blocking when queue depth spikes.

sre-oncall: Immediate mitigations proposal (executing now):
1) Set batch_window_ms=40 in us-east scheduler config to shrink batches.
2) Force eviction of requests older than 5s from runtime queue to break HOL.
3) Scale scheduler replicas +3 in us-east.
4) Apply temporary rate limit for non-enterprise orgs to 20 rps to reduce load.

platform-ops: Running changes now. Commands: 
```
kubectl -n platform patch configmap scheduler-config --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/batch_window_ms","value":"40"}]'
kubectl -n runtime scale deployment scheduler-us-east --replicas=8
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/evict -d '{"age_ms":5000}'
# apply rate-limit rule
curl -X POST https://ops-api.internal/rate-limits -d '{"scope":"non-enterprise","rps":20}'
```

scheduler-eng-rajesh: Enabling priority preemption and smaller batch window. Watching metrics: queue_depth and batch_wait_time. I can also enable `--enable-priority-preempt` on the scheduler to allow small, latency-sensitive requests to jump the queue.

sre-1: Taking over the pager for the next 30m. Confirmed I can apply the preemption flag and watch the rollout. If queue doesn't drop within 15m, will route ACME to fallback region (us-west).

customer-success-leah: Notified ACME support and shared mitigation steps + ETA ~15-20m. They've asked for updates every 5m.

sre-oncall: First status check: after scale + batch_window change p95 error rate dropped from ~18% -> ~6%, overall 502s decreased. Still seeing tail 504s for requests that hit nodes with high KV eviction pressure.

ingress-eng-maya: Logs after mitigation: fewer upstream closes. KV cache eviction rate increased (expected) and mem usage trending down.
```
[09:22:10] batcher: enqueue wait=120ms; queue_size=8920
[09:22:11] upstream: proxy to scheduler ok 200
```

eng-oncall: Next steps (post-mitigation): 1) Re-run canary tests for v2.3.4 to validate batch_window change. 2) Add rollout guard in CI to prevent batch_window jumps >2x without a flagged SLO check. 3) Root cause follow-up: why KV growth + deployment together caused HOL.

infra-bot: Metric snapshot: 
- queue_depth(us-east): 24.1k -> 8.9k (post-mitigations)
- 5xx-rate(us-east): 18% -> 5.8%
- p95 latency tokens: 5.4s -> 1.1s

sre-1: I'll stay on incident and coordinate routing for ACME if needed. Creating a follow-up ticket INC-20260315-01-FOLLOWUP for postmortem and config hardening.

incident-bot: Incident INC-20260315-01 updated: severity=P1 -> monitoring (mitigations applied). Assigned owner: sre-1.

sre-oncall: Leaving handoff notes: applied batch_window rollback to 40ms, enabled priority preempt, scaled scheduler replicas, evicted old requests, applied temporary rate-limits. Watchlist: KV cache growth, batch_size distribution, canary rollout guard. Handoff to sre-1.

sre-1: Acknowledged. I will monitor for 60m, coordinate CS updates, and if stable kick off rollback to stable defaults with an RFC.

customer-success-leah: ACME confirmed reduced errors and will re-test their flows. They've requested a postmortem and ETA on GA fix.

eng-oncall: Filing RFC: "hardening-batch-window-rollouts" and adding smoke tests around batching behavior.

incident-bot: Close plan: keep incident open until two consecutive 15m windows with 5xx rate <1% and queue depth <2k. Next update in 10m."
